jobs_results.title: Fullstack Developer (react + python)
jobs_results.description:
На связи Eightify. Наш основной продукт — саммари для YouTube с использованием ChatGPT. Основной рынок — US и UK. Проекту нет ещё и года, но он уже вышел в прибыль!

Это не единственный продукт компании, но все объединяет идея извлечения сути и сигнала из шумного потока информации. Сейчас мы запускаем AI-generated медиа: новости на основе различных источников.

Мы ищем в команду full-time разработчика — Senior Full Stack, который хочет 100% времени делать продукт, без корпоративного bullshit.

Tasks

Чем придётся заниматься?

Фокус на двух вещах
• Классный продукт. Крутой UX и качество summary. Одна функция, которая работает лучше конкурентов. Проверь сам.
• Мы зарабатываем деньги. Провели 20+ A/B тестов монетизации и продолжаем.

У нас нет лишних встреч, долгих обсуждений, бессмысленной бюрократии.

Requirements

Стек?
• Backend — Python / Flask
• Frontend App — React (iframe внутри extension, почти все изменения вносятся сюда)
• Chrome Extension — TypeScript
• iOS App — React... Native
• GCP, Docker, Gitlab, Metabase, Postgres, Stripe

Как понять, что мы сработаемся?
• Ты быстро катишь в прод
• ты умеешь выкинуть лишнее, любишь готовые решения и пользуешься github copilot
• ты делаешь быстро, а мы не мучаем вопросами “ну как там?”
• Ты готов много работать
• от 170 до 240 часов в месяц интенсивной, быстрой и сложной работы
• part-time или совмещение с другим проектом — точно нет
• Ты — senior разработчик
• чтобы делать быстрые костыльные решения нужно быть senior разработчиком, иначе это просто плохие решения
• если ты “перфекционист” или любишь оверинжиниринг — не сможем работать вместе
• опыт и насмотренность: оптимизировать SQL запрос, подключить кеширование в redis, знаешь, что такое нормальное распределение 😅
• опыт работы с Python и React желателен, — онбординг будет быстрее

Benefits

Про условия:
• Удалённая работа
• Контракт с US-компанией
• Зарплата в $$$ — любым способом (банковский перевод, Wise, крипта)
• От 170 до 240 часов в месяц интенсивной, быстрой и сложной работы
• Оплата — от $30 до $40 в час

Почему это классная возможность
• Работа с AI и GPT — на этапе рабочего продукта, а не GPT ради GPT.
• Будешь видеть результат работы: выкатил и видишь изменение метрик через пару дней.
• Работа на рынке US и зарплата в $$$.
• Никаких лишний корпоративных процессов.

Команда?

Твоим руководителем будет Леша Катаев, ex-CTO Skyeng. Каждую неделю Леша тратит целый день, чтобы решить, какие 3-4 задачи дадут максимальный рост. Чтобы ни у кого в команде не было тревоги из-за 500 задач в беклоге.

У нас небольшая команда: 1 разработчик, UX-дизайнер и DevOps инженер.

Это очень крутые ребята. Приятно работать, когда знаешь, что с тобой работают классные люди, которым тоже интересно. Которые разделяют с тобой те же принципы и тот же движ 😅 С которыми приятно общаться и которым можно доверять. Это такая команда.

Наши принципы:
• Цели — продукт, пользователи, выручка, прибыль; не одобрение инвесторов, журналистов, друзей.
• Фокус на цели: на задачах, которые приблизят к результату, никаких “полезных задач”; готовые и простые решения — 🔥, костыльные решения — 🔥
• Рациональное принятие решений и правда.
• Небольшая команда full stack

jobs_results.title: Senior Full Stack (React+Java) Developer
jobs_results.description:
Project Description

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer (React+Java) to join us for a new project in the fashion retailing industry.

It's a high-visibility role in an Agile team — therefore, communication, polite English, and experience working in a distributed multinational environment are required.

Responsibilities
• Develop software components according to business/functional requirements
• Support the integration testing of developed services
• Endure development's quality and cleanliness (Clean Code).
• Ensure the quality and success of the delivered solutions.
• Develop unit tests.
• Develop a visually attractive and usable user interface.
• Communicate ideas, new methods, or technologies to improve the current technology stack.
• Participate actively in the API design.
• Collaborate with the rest of the team, helping them to grow and strengthen the company's technological community.
• Analyze existing system source code and propose improvements when necessary
• Work in... a multinational distributed agile team with peers located in different cities in Poland, Spain, Serbia, Romania.

Skills

Must have
• Minimum 3 years of experience with React and 2 years in Java.
• English B2 or higher.
• Strong OOP skills.
• Deep knowledge of software design patterns.
• Solid experience in core Java.
• Knowledge of Java 11 new features.
• Experience with J2EE, Spring framework, JDBC.
• Excellent SQL knowledge.
• JavaScript and Typescript development experience.
• Development experience in React, Redux and Hooks.
• Development of unit tests.
• CI/CD platform knowledge.
• Gitflow knowledge and work experience.
• API First knowledge of work experience.
• API REST and microservices work experience.
• Knowledge of Domain Driven Design and Hexagonal architecture.

Nice to have
• Minimum 3 years of experience with React and 2 years in Java.
• English B2 or higher.
• Strong OOP skills.
• Deep knowledge of software design patterns.
• Solid experience in core Java.
• Knowledge of Java 11 new features.
• Experience with J2EE, Spring framework, JDBC.
• Excellent SQL knowledge.
• JavaScript and Typescript development experience.
• Development experience in React, Redux and Hooks.
• Development of unit tests.
• CI/CD platform knowledge.
• Gitflow knowledge and work experience.
• API First knowledge of work experience.
• API REST and microservices work experience.
• Knowledge of Domain Driven Design and Hexagonal architecture.

Languages

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
THE COMPANY

Hello, we are Workpath, a B2B startup in the heart of Munich. We want companies and teams to work as effectively and inspired as possible. This is why we built a platform which streamlines goal setting, enables autonomous teams and simplifies cross collaboration. We pride ourselves in building a product which is easy and fun to use.

Most of our team is located in Munich or elsewhere in Germany, but we have a handful of software engineers working from Spain.

THE STACK

Our frontend is a single-page application, built with a mix of ES6 and TypeScript, as well as React. Further technologies we use are react-query, styled components, jest and react-testing-library.

On the backend we use Ruby on Rails, Postgres and Redis. Our infrastructure is hosted on AWS, and we have a solid CI/CD setup which allows us to spin up QA environments and deploy to production with a simple click of a button.

THE JOB

Here is where you come in: We are looking for a Frontend Engineer - React... (f/m/d) who enjoys creating business applications with great UX. You will work with a small but highly experienced, diverse and fun team of engineers, designers and product specialists. Some of the challenges you will face:
• Ship exciting features, enriched with animations and great UX.
• Eliminate tech debt and reduce inconsistencies. (Yes, you will get dedicated refactoring time!)
• Work with your colleagues to improve processes, architecture, and all other aspects of your work.

You will also:
• Have a say in which product features are developed.
• Own projects across the whole development lifecycle.
• Shape architectural, technical and organizational decisions.

WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF …
• You have demonstrated ownership and autonomy at work.
• You have deep knowledge in developing complex, scalable and cross-browser user interfaces and component libraries using React.
• Your foundations are solid. You have in-depth CSS experience and know how the browser works under the hood.
• You promote and apply software craftsmanship, clean code and robust tests.
• You have contributed to architectural decisions. You know how to break down a larger problem into smaller steps.
• An intuitive understanding of good design, typography and UX.
• Your desire to teach and learn is bigger than your ego.
• Excellent communication skills and fluent English. You are able to present complicated solutions to non-technical audiences in a simple and logical way.

WHY YOU SHOULD BE INTERESTED

Since work is a huge part of your life we want it to be interesting and fun. We work hard, we care for each other and always walk away satisfied. We constantly refine our approach and everyone has a say. If you like a challenge you will love it here.
• Opportunity to develop along our technical or team leadership career paths.
• A strong team and feedback culture, as well as collaboration in an agile working environment of mutual support and very flat hierarchies.
• A lot of personal responsibility, autonomy and creative involvement in shaping our growth, check our Youtube Podcast and listen to our team members.
• Remote work from anywhere in Spain, with a regular unlimited employment contract.
• Competitive compensation in addition to benefits & perks such as mobility subsidy through Edenred, and personal development budget.
• Regular paid visits to our Munich office for company events.

If you made it until here you probably want to talk to us. Hit the apply button

jobs_results.title: Sr front end developer
jobs_results.description:
Perfil buscado (Hombre/Mujer)

As a Design Technologist you will split your time between execution and strategy. You will be contributing to the definition of new ad products, pre-sales prototypes and custom campaign execution, all while working directly with Designers, Product Managers, Engineers and Account teams.
• Owning the end-to-end development process and deliverables from a design and technical perspective
• Participating in the full lifecycle of design and development -- including ideation, prototyping, development, backwards compatibility, fail-overs, validation, and user-testing.
Work closely with business teams to develop campaign strategy, use cases, and technical requirements.
Presenting work to peers, product teams and executive leadership
Develop high quality scalable and maintainable solutions.
Partnering with program and product managers to appropriately identify and assess features for future product offerings.
Proven web development experience across multiple... devices, web-views and browsers and ability to simplify complex problems into intuitive and elegant experiences.
To deliver functional prototypes on new devices and communicate complex concepts clearly and persuasively across different audiences and varying levels of the organization.

• Front-End/Web Development Engineer|+6 months Project
• Considerable experience as lead designer, developer or technologist, strong front-end proficiency and equally passionate about web design and development.
• Understanding and fluent usage across a broad spectrum of technologies including (but not limited to): Vanilla JS, NodeJS, React, Redux, SASS/CSS, and Responsive/Adaptive Design.
• Feeling comfortable reading, writing, and reviewing vanilla JavaScript both on the client and server, building your own libraries and creating task automation to speed up development.
• Experience using AWS in production environments and understanding of performance and how to mitigate latency issues. Familiarity with the AWS stack and configuration: S3, CloudFront, Lambda, Route 53, EC2.
• Familiarity with digital marketing, advertising, and metrics across Entertainment and Automotive verticals
• Familiar with design tools like Sketch and Figma, with Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality, Alexa, Voice Design, WebGL and creative frontend.
• Familiarity with using the Bash scripting/shell and SSH.
• Excellent written/verbal communication, presentation, interpersonal and analytical skills
• BS/MS in computer science, technology, design, or equivalent professional experience.

OUr client is Amazon, probably the most important Company in distribution and retail industry in the world.

Big opportunity to join Amazon and develop an excellent job with outstanding salary conditions as well
